acceptance.deviation: Root cgroups not approved by the owner; rootless podman --memory is not enforced here (cgroupfs manager, memory.max=max inside). cg-run.sh uses RLIMIT_AS (ulimit -v) instead. True cgroup OOM-kill tests (BRK-RES-001 exit-137 behaviour) are deferred.

heap_note: Heaps are the scripts/it/up.sh defaults (OS_HEAP/ES_HEAP); RSS figures are approximate from earlier IT runs on this box. Load tasks (L1L) use a 2 GB heap.
